claim.claim-text: 1. A robot system (400) comprising: a body (408) comprising:

operate the movable end-effector (422, 424), the movable end-effector (422, 424) experiencing an end-effector force based on operation of the movable end-effector (422, 424), the intermediate body section (408a) experiencing a first linear force based on the end-effector force ; and operate the one or more legs (404, 406) so that a second linear force experienced by the intermediate body section (408a) based on a reaction force counteracts the first linear force.
2. The robot system (400) of claim 1, wherein the second linear force directionally opposes the first linear force.
3. The robot system (400) of claim 1 or 2, wherein the control system (417) is further configured to:

position the intermediate body section (408c) using a first set of degrees of freedom based on operation of the one or more legs (404, 406); and position the intermediate body section (408c) using a second set of degrees of freedom based on the operation of the movable end-effector (422, 424).
4. The robot system (400) of claim 1 or 2, wherein the control system (417) is further configured to:

position the intermediate body section (408c) using a first set of degrees of freedom based on operation of the one or more legs (404, 406); and position the intermediate body section (408c) using a second set of degrees of freedom based on the operation of the movable end-effector (422, 424), wherein the control system is constrained from positioning the intermediate body section using the first set of degrees of freedom based on the operation of the movable end-effector (422, 424).
5. The robot system (400) of any of claims 1-4, wherein the reaction force balances the body (408).
6. The robot system (400) of any of claims 1-5, wherein the robot system (400) is balanced based on operation of the one or more legs (404, 406).

7. The robot system (400) of any of claims 1-6, wherein to operate the movable end-effector (422, 424), the control system (417) is further configured to: operate the movable end-effector (422, 424) to manipulate an object in an environment of the robot system (400) or support a load.
8. The robot system (400) of any of claims 1-7, wherein the second linear force is based on reaction forces experienced by multiple legs of the one or more legs (404, 406).
9. The robot system (400) of any of claims 1-8, wherein the control system is further configured to: determine the first linear force.
10. A method for controlling a robot system (400), the method comprising:

operating, by a control system (417) of the robot system (400), a movable end-effector (422, 424) of an upper body section of the robot system (400), the movable end-effector (422, 424) experiencing an end-effector force based on operation of the movable end-effector (422, 424), an intermediate body section (408c) of the robot system (400) coupling the upper body section (408b) and a lower body section (408a) of the robot system (400), the intermediate body section (408a) experiencing a first linear force based on the end-effector force ; and operating, by the control system (417), one or more legs (404, 406) of the lower body section (408a) so that a second linear force experienced by the intermediate body section (408a) based on a reaction force counteracts the first linear force, each leg of the one or more legs (404, 406) configured to contact a surface and thereby experience respective reaction forces from the surface.
11. The method of claim 10, wherein the second linear force directionally opposes the first linear force.
12. The method of claim 10 or 11, further comprising:

positioning the intermediate body section (408c) using a first set of degrees of freedom based on operation of the one or more legs (404, 406); and positioning the intermediate body section (408c) using a second set of degrees of freedom based on the operation of the movable end-effector (422, 424), wherein the control system is constrained from positioning the intermediate body section using the first set of degrees of freedom based on the operation of the movable end-effector (422, 424).
13. The method of any of claims 10-12, wherein the robot system (400) is balanced based on operation of the one or more legs (404, 406).
14. The method of any of claims 10-13, wherein the second linear force is based on reaction forces experienced by multiple legs of the one or more legs (404, 406).
15. The method of any of claims 10-14, further comprising: determining the first linear force.
